#217 · Hibernator Pokémon

Ursaring

Normal

Johto · Generation 2

Ursaring is a Normal-type Hibernator Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 125.8 kg. It evolves from Teddiursa and into Ursaluna. Its highest base stat is Attack (130), with a base stat total of 500.
